one_sentence_goal: Every serious lead creates one visible sales record, one next action, and the correct follow-up without flooding the pipeline with cold imports.
decisions: FOUNDING STUDENTS is the customer sales pipeline.
SLM Affiliate Lifecycle is the Partner pipeline.
OUTREACH ENGINE can track partner targets. It is not the customer sales pipeline.
Bulk cold-email imports create contacts only. They never create sales opportunities.
A positive reply, trial start, calculator completion, or booked call can create the one customer sales opportunity.
Every later event updates that same open opportunity instead of creating another one.
GHL authenticated views are the MVP dashboard because they are private, maintainable, and already connected to the records.
Routine success appears on the dashboard. Only events requiring a person or an exception send an alert.

Confirm that a Follow-up outcome must include the next task and due date.

tests: Bulk cold import
100 contacts create 100 contacts and zero Founding Students opportunities.
Positive reply
One positive reply creates or updates one opportunity at In Chase, one task, and one alert. Sender sequence pauses.
Repeat reply
A second reply updates the same opportunity and does not create another open task for the same unresolved reply event.
Booked call
A fresh booking produces one opportunity at Call Booked, one appointment ID, and no duplicate.
Held call
Marking Showed moves the same opportunity to Call Held. Calendar end time alone does nothing.
No-show
Confirmed no-show starts E2 once and moves the same opportunity to In Chase.
Cancellation
Cancelled appointment never starts E2 and never receives a no-show tag.
Rebooking
Rebooking stops active no-show recovery. A later distinct no-show can start one new recovery.
Trial Day 5
An eligible trial with no booked call creates one Alex task and one alert.
Trial suppression
Booked, purchased, ended, or ineligible trials create no Day 5 task.
Existing active trials
A bounded backfill creates at most one task per eligible trial and does not flood alerts.
Influencer gift
One gifting event creates one Mia task and one notification. Repeat processing of the same event creates nothing.
Partner application
AF1 creates one Partner opportunity. AF2 and onboarding move the same record.
Thinkific activation
Access granted and first login stay separate. Unknown login data displays unavailable, never zero.
